title: Declared dependencies and runtime configuration
description: Begins with an everyday explanation, then traces dependencies in .github/workflows/ci.yml. Source units combined: Declared dependencies and runtime configuration.

learning_objectives.text: Explain declared dependencies and runtime configuration in plain language using the project source.
Trace `dependencies` in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and explain its inputs, behavior, and output.
Use a test or boundary case to assess what the implementation proves and what remains unverified.

practical_outcomes: Explain one data or control boundary.
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and the source exercise.
Answer ten module questions using lesson evidence.
Distinguish actual code behavior from assumptions and proposed extensions.
